Title: Database Migration Assessment for Oracle - GA

Body.Content:
The Database Migration Assessment for Oracle extension in Azure Data Studio is a tool that assists you in planning and executing a migration from your existing Oracle database to Microsoft's data platform. It provides a detailed analysis of the current Oracle database environment and provides recommendations for migration, including identifying any code compatibility issues, right sizing the Azure target, and mapping features between Oracle and Azure. The ultimate goal is to ensure a smooth and successful migration to Microsoft's data platform.

Learn more
